source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

251010.title: Natural calcium phosphates (phosphate rock)
251010.boundary: The rock itself; excludes acid and finished fertilizer. Some producers restrict exports.

310530.title: Diammonium phosphate (DAP)
310530.boundary: A finished phosphate fertilizer; Morocco, China, Russia, US, Saudi lead.

310540.title: Monoammonium phosphate (MAP) and mixes
310540.boundary: Finished phosphate fertilizer heading; contents vary.

310420.title: Potassium chloride (potash)
310420.boundary: The K nutrient; Canada, Russia, Belarus dominate — the potash chokepoint, not phosphate.

280470.title: Phosphorus (elemental)
280470.boundary: Industrial white/yellow P4, not fertilizer; small, China-dominated.
